title: Bug 659561: Make FI depreciation posting buffer temporary
summary: The FI depreciation posting buffer table is now marked as temporary to fix validation checks for local permissions and cloud migration, since it is only used in memory.
key_points: Buffer table changed from persistent to temporary
Existing application permissions and legacy buffer unchanged
Table introduced in 30.0, not present in earlier release branches
quote: Make the buffer temporary and explicitly exclude it from cloud migration.
